aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

autoComplete.description: The autocomplete hint for the first character input and the form input.

autoFocus.description: Focus the first character input on mount.

autoSubmit.description: Submit the associated form when the code becomes complete.

children.description: Character inputs and optional decorative separators. When omitted, the field renders one OTPFieldInput per character.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

defaultValue.description: The initial code for an uncontrolled field.

disabled.description: Disable all the character inputs and omit the code from form submission.

error.description: Display the field in an error state.

form.description: The ID of the form that owns the field.

getInputAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for a character after the first. Positions start at one. For localization purposes, you can use the provided translations.

helperText.description: The supporting or error text displayed below the inputs.

id.description: The ID of the first character input. Subsequent input IDs are derived from it.

inputMode.description: The virtual keyboard hint. Defaults to the keyboard for the validation type.

inputRef.description: A ref to the first visible character input.

label.description: The label associated with the first character input.

length.description: The number of characters in the code. When passing children, match the number of OTPFieldInput elements.

mask.description: Mask the characters as they are entered.

name.description: The name used to submit the field value as one string.

normalizeValue.description: Normalize the filtered code before it is stored. The function should be idempotent.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new code and the change details. The change can be canceled.

onValueComplete.description: Called when the code becomes complete or a complete code is pasted, before optional form submission.

onValueInvalid.description: Called with the attempted input when filtering or normalization rejects characters.

readOnly.description: Keep the field focusable while preventing edits.

required.description: Require a complete code before form submission.

slotProps.description: Props for the Material slots and their corresponding Base UI parts.

slots.description: Components used to render the field's slots.

sx.description: System styles for the outer root element.

validationType.description: The set of characters accepted in the code.

value.description: The code when controlling the field. Use an empty string for an empty field.

slotDescriptions.group: The host for Base UI OTPField.Root.
slotDescriptions.label: The visible field label.
